items.html: And in Gadlut he also takes his own and hers, and afterward only her BaN is given to her for her Partzuf, and of MaH only its illumination, which are only the illumination of the Hasadim, and not its essence, for its essence remains in him. And the opposite in BaN, for its essence is in her and in him there is only illumination. Nevertheless, since he took it first, he has a root greater than hers, and therefore his Daat is complete. But the female did not take from MaH except its illumination alone, and her essence is from BaN, and therefore her Daat is light even in Gadlut.
